summary: Add paired iOS launch, JavaScript error and native crash/hang diagnostics with bounded private capture and durable node-local ingestion.

replay.detail: No replicated replay or backfill. Diagnostics and retry receipts are node-local.

schema.detail: Add the local client_diagnostic_receipts table, client subject family, and client.launch/client.js-error/client.native-crash/client.hang claim kinds. Registry digest changes; storage schema version is unchanged. Local retention policy and canonical audit exclude these facts from replicated projections.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet admission rule change.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/client/diagnostics and write.client-diagnostics are new. Older daemons lack the route; the phone checks capability before upload. Existing paired grants remain unchanged. Rate-limit responses use the public rate-limited code; the phone drops terminal rejected batches, pauses on authentication refusal, and honours Retry-After.

downtime.detail: No coordinated shutdown or service interruption required.

manual.detail: Previously paired devices must re-pair to acquire write.client-diagnostics. No automatic scope expansion of existing grants.

recovery.detail: Rollback leaves node-local receipts and bounded captured diagnostics unused; no replicated conversion or recovery procedure is required.
